correctness.rationale: For all n>1 including prime powers, the defining recurrence implies an exact multivariate series. Coefficient extraction at a maximal exponent factors 2^A, and the remaining denominator has 2-adically invertible constant 1. Mod-2 reduction yields the product of binomial coefficients, whose parity is exactly the Lucas binary-submask condition. Independent exact recursion verified 780 exponent signatures, not used as the universal proof.

value.rationale: Fink 2023 explicitly asks about the normalized κ0(n)/2^A sequence. Classifying its first binary digit simultaneously for all positive integers and arbitrarily many prime factors gives a complete natural sharpness locus for the established bound, unlike a finite enumeration or arbitrary parameter restriction. Does not solve the higher-bit question.
